title: Incremental reader snapshot: stream-maintained aggregates replace the full read
description:
What: replace reading every vote and profile with aggregates updated from DynamoDB Streams, one record per change. Public output keeps counts, means and histograms only (who rated stays private).
Acceptance:
Scenario: One vote costs a constant number of calls
  Given 5,000 votes exist
  When one more vote arrives
  Then the snapshot update makes the same number of calls as with 200 votes
